summary_1line: Bhishma explains duties toward women and detailed inheritance rules for sons of different caste wives, emphasizing hierarchy, compassion, and social order.

image_candidates.scene_text: The aged Bhishma lies on a bed of arrows while Yudhishthira stands beside him listening to his teachings on law and inheritance.
A Brahmana household with multiple wives of different castes standing apart as property shares are symbolically divided among their sons.
